_meta.description: Known-good eval-floor baseline for the regression gate (bin/eval-regression). L1 = code-assertion graders; L2 = COHERENCE judge agreement vs independent labels. Generated offline from coherence_golden.json + the prod_baseline_selections fixture; no model calls. Regenerate with bin/eval-regression --update after an intended change.
_meta.gate: fail if any L1 check flips PASS->FAIL, L2 fail-precision drops, or L2 leak_count rises.
_meta.known_leaks_note: leak_count=2 reflects the historical production judge against corrected labels: 2 cases (Gemini 3.5 Flash version, Boeing -4%) where a true specific was sourced only from a non-cited cluster article. The WRITE + COHERENCE prompts have been fixed (cite all backing articles; verify cited-sources-only) and validated to catch these; regenerate judge verdicts over the full golden set with the fixed judge to certify leak_count back to 0.
